caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular composition divided diagonally from the upper left to the lower right by two parallel yellow lines with a patterned border of diamond shapes in green, yellow, and blue. The rectangular area is filled with various floral and geometric motifs, each sectioning off into distinct areas of design and color. In the upper left triangle, there is a stylized floral pattern with large green, yellow, light blue, brown, and pink shapes against a muted green background, bordered with small geometric forms in red, orange, and green. The upper right section, separated by the diagonal, features a yellow and green flower with a red center on a dark green background, and adjacent to it, against a red field, there are white and light blue flowers with yellow centers and green leaves. The lower right section displays a sunburst-like motif with yellow, green, and blue elements on a light blue background, intersected by a smaller green and red motif. The bottom strip of the rectangle contains repeating yellow floral patterns with green centers and red backgrounds. The entire composition is framed by a double black and gray stitched border, and the background of the image is an off-white or cream color. The name "VIRGINIA BUFFANO" is written in black letters in the lower right corner outside the bordered rectangle.
